notes.title: Hungry Horrors Now Playable on Steam Deck
notes.content: [h2][b]Hungry Horrors Now Playable on Steam Deck[/b][/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45178714/5a5d961dbed0c7259345183bfa0a98091736f68e.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We are excited to share that Hungry Horrors is now fully playable on Steam Deck. The demo runs smoothly on Valve’s handheld, making it a perfect way to cook up dishes and feed Horrors on the go.[/p][p][/p][p]If you are playing on other handheld devices that support Steam, such as the ASUS ROG Ally or Lenovo Legion Go, you can also jump in there.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45178714/957069536fcb257436545ce2e572721fb6fdb27c.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Give it a try on your deck and let us know what you think.[/p][p][/p][p][b][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3530560/Hungry_Horrors_Demo/"]Demo[/url][/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45178714/e5b5ac3d4112ced2233076a39588ade50847452c.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: First Steam Patch Now Live!
notes.content: [h1]First Steam Patch Now Live![/h1][h3]Hey everyone,[/h3][h3]Our first Steam patch for [i]Hungry Horrors[/i] is now live![/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45178714/4d2ec4b265d1d6c5138e2f7f771cf49a19066122.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]🍽️ Early Translations[/b][/h3][p]You can now try the demo in:[/p][list][*][p]Japanese[/p][/*][*][p]Korean[/p][/*][*][p]Simplified Chinese[/p][/*][*][p]Traditional Chinese[/p][/*][*][p]Spanish[/p][/*][*][p]Brazilian Portuguese[/p][/*][*][p]Polish[/p][/*][*][p]Ukrainian[/p][/*][*][p]Russian[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]⚠️ These translations are very early drafts. Many lines are still unedited, inconsistent, or just plain wrong. We are working through them, and your feedback helps a lot.[/p][p]👉 [url="https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScgvDKGAJyiDDheo-RH5bfz2JMU7vx3ftUpyFWfRzeEiE-XDg/viewform?usp=sharing&ouid=113152748633582348044"]Send translation feedback[/url][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]🔥 Feature Highlights[/b][/h3][p][/p][list][*][p]🗺️ The [b]bog biome[/b] is now revealed after completing the demo[/p][/*][*][p]📊 A [b]run summary screen[/b] now appears when you die, showing stats and items you unlocked[/p][/*][*][p]📦 [b]Unlock popups[/b] now trigger properly when gaining new items[/p][/*][*][p]♻️ You can [b]reroll buffs[/b] in exchange for gold[/p][/*][*][p]🧠 [b]In-battle tooltips and reminders[/b] help explain what’s happening[/p][/*][*][p]🧂 [b]Dish info[/b] is now viewable during battle[/p][/*][*][p]🎮 [b]Full keyboard-only controls[/b] are now supported[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]🛠️ Improvements[/b][/h3][p][/p][list][*][p]👣 Princess' footsteps now have sound[/p][/*][*][p]📍 Notification when entering a new biome[/p][/*][*][p]🧱 Floor visuals raised slightly for better clarity[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]🐞 Key Fixes[/b][/h3][p][/p][list][*][p]🗨️ Speech bubbles now appear more centrally[/p][/*][*][p]🧾 Tooltips no longer cut off in loot chests with 4 or more items[/p][/*][*][p]🍽️ Turn-skipping effects now properly skip the turn[/p][/*][*][p]🚪 Runs can’t be abandoned from the kitchen or tutorial[/p][/*][*][p]🌐 CJK fonts now wrap correctly thanks to bundled text server data[/p][/*][*][p]🧹 Plus a whole bunch of smaller bug fixes based on your feedback[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Full patch notes: [url="https://hungryhorrorsgame.com/patch-notes.html"]Read on our website[/url][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]We know this patch took a little longer than expected. Since releasing the demo, we’ve had a few surprises: an earthquake, a broken arm, and a lot of cockroaches.[/p][p]You can read the full chaos report here: [url="https://clumsybearstudio.com/blog/post-008-launching-our-first-steam-demo.html"]Developer blog[/url][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]We’re now back on track and plan to update the game regularly.[/p][p]The next patch will focus more on [b]balance[/b] and [b]new features[/b], so your feedback really matters.[/p][p][/p][p]📩 [url="https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScdHiBjSCiJxz1Zs-nv5kFK92QKKIM4Rx3pmR-IUT2QU8ThdQ/viewform?usp=sharing&ouid=113152748633582348044"]Send feedback here[/url][/p][p]🐾 Or join us on [url="https://discord.gg/Y6hyjk9XaK"]Discord[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for playing. We’re reading everything and cooking up plenty more.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p]

notes.title: 🎉 The Hungry Horrors Demo is Out Now
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=ZkDSWMvGif8;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]🎉 The Hungry Horrors Demo is Out Now![/h1]

[h2]The moment has come. The first public demo of Hungry Horrors is live.[/h2]

Begin your run as a cursed princess and make your way through biomes inspired by British and Irish folklore. Play cards. Feed monsters. Hope they don’t hate what you serve.

The demo includes:
	[list]
[*] The full first biome, with three monsters and one boss
[*] Dozens of traditional dishes to prepare and play
[*] Buffs through spices, herbs, condiments, and utensils
[*] Permanent upgrades and item unlocks between runs
[*] Fatalities unique to each monster if they catch you
[/list]

This is an early slice of the full game. Your feedback, bug reports, and thoughts will help us improve what’s next.

💬 Join the community on Discord: [url=https://discord.gg/Y6hyjk9XaK]https://discord.gg/Y6hyjk9XaK[/url]
📝 You can now leave a review for demos on Steam. If you have a moment, it helps us a great deal with visibility.


Thanks for playing,
Jerzy
Clumsy Bear Studio
